subject: Discovery recap & technical handoff planning
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@eunoiahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + next technical handoff

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we heard: Eunoia is evaluating an LLM-powered assistant for care-coordination; primary constraints are 99th percentile latency <= 300ms, cost targets roughly $0.003/token, and strict PHI handling for a small set of fields.
- Risks to clarify: sample data format, retention window, and whether any models must run inside a VPC/on-prem.

Proposal: schedule a 60–90 minute technical handoff next week with our ML + infra engineers to walk architecture, run a short demo of a representative request path, and align on integration and security scope. Draft agenda (open to edits):
  1) Introductions & goals (10m)
  2) Architecture & model choices (20m)
  3) Demo: inference flow + latency profile (20m)
  4) Data handling, retention & compliance (15m)
  5) Q&A & mutual action items (15–25m)

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (call notes), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (proposed milestones).

Can you share a few 60–90 minute blocks that work for your engineering and security leads? Timezone listed below is PT. Once you confirm a slot we’ll loop in Marcus and Neha for the deep technical sections.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@eunoiahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya@eunoiahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next technical handoff

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. Priya (security lead) and I are available next week but our windows are constrained because of vendor audits. High-level availability (PT):

- Tue 9 May: 09:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 10 May: 13:30–16:30

A couple quick asks before the handoff so Priya can prep:
- Please include someone from your security/compliance team or an engineer familiar with our potential SOC2 evidence paths.
- Can you send a short list of model size(s) / memory footprint and expected token rates so we can check infra fit?
- We will attach a brief security questionnaire on Friday — can your team review during the session?

If the 60–90min window on Wed 10 works for your infra folks that would be my preference.

-Samir
Samir Shah
Director, Product & Partnerships
Eunoia Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next technical handoff

Great — Wed 10 May works for us. Two candidate slots (PT) so we can pick the one that fits your roster:

Option A: Wed 10 May, 14:00–15:30 PT (90 min)
Option B: Wed 10 May, 15:00–16:00 PT (60 min — tighter but doable if we trim the demo)

I’ve added a short draft agenda and a Calendly link if you prefer to book directly: https://calendly.com/redwood/60min-tdx. Also uploaded the call notes and MAP here: https://drive.redwood.com/s/discovery-MP-20280502.

Action items for you if we lock a slot:
- Confirm which option you prefer and which external attendees will join (security + platform eng names)
- If you can share a sample request/response schema or anonymized record schema ahead of time, Marcus can prepare a targeted latency/caching plan.

Marcus & Neha — can you confirm you’ll join the Wed 10 block if we pick Option A? I expect Marcus will lead the runbook + infra section and Neha will field deployment/SLAs.

Thanks — I’ll hold both slots tentatively until EOD PT tomorrow.

—Marissa
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next technical handoff

Marissa — I’ll join Option A (14:00–15:30 PT) and will cover the infra/runbook sections. Quick notes for agenda and prep:

- Attendees we need from our side: Marcus Lin (infra), Neha Kapoor (deploy/SLA), Marissa (solutions) — I’ll also bring an SRE for the demo environment if we want to run an end-to-end trace.
- Prep requests for Eunoia: sample request size (avg tokens in prompt + completion), expected QPS, and whether PHI fields are masked before sending. Attach any schema to the Drive link.
- Topics I plan to cover: serving topology, caching & KV strategies, quantization/instance sizing, fallback policies, and integration checklist for private vs hosted deployment.
- If Priya will bring compliance questions, I can carve 10–15 minutes for evidence flow (what logs/audit we can provide, retention options).

On the agenda draft, I recommend we aim for 90 minutes so we have room for the evidence discussion — Option A please.

Thanks — Marcus
